notes.title: Launcher Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215442/aaf87612d523f710ce9bb8787a55a28cb5e69c95.png

Welcome to the new update! 
We have added a special FoxSox Games Launcher to our games. 
The launcher automatically starts only when you begin the game and closes immediately after the game starts. Its main purpose is to inform you about the latest updates in our game offerings. This is an optional feature, so you can choose to skip it and go directly to the game by selecting the appropriate option when launching the game.

Additionally, we've implemented a few minor improvements that enhance performance and fix some minor bugs in the game.

notes.title: Update 2.0 - Steam Deck
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41215442/00d7456a061a777150ceebcd764b3b9f9e82da79.jpg

Welcome to another update! Although Goat's Tale has not yet passed verification, we would like to inform you that we have taken the first steps, so now you can comfortably enjoy our game on the Steam Deck! There are still some minor improvements ahead, but at this moment, you can enjoy our production!

Update 2.0

 Adjusted the game's resolution for the Steam Deck.
 Added information about controller support.
 Added buttons that link to our other games.
 Fixed several minor bugs.
 Full DX11 game support has been implemented to enhance game performance (native DX9 version has been removed)


In the near future, we will also work on fixing some graphical issues that we are aware of and adding full DLC integration for the Steam Deck.
